result:
Refined asks are now recorded, indexed per module and routed, and merged into `michael/dev`. I did one thing wrong along the way (below).

- **Counts:** 1,080 asks recorded, 19 crossed off as done, 612 sent to their module's inbox. 449 stay open because they are site-wide or have no module folder.
- **Where it lives:**
  - The record is one line per ask in each session's `asks.jsonl`.
  - The per-module lists are `doc/refined-asks.md`, and the overview is [asks-by-module](/framework/ai/doc/asks-by-module.md).
  - [How it works](/framework/ext/Refine/doc/asks.md) is linked from the Refine readme. `Server/AskIndex.mjs` does the filing, and `RefineQueue` calls it after each refined prompt.
- **Page name differs from the brief:** it is `refined-asks.md`, not `asks.md`. Four modules already had a hand-merged `asks.md`, and I didn't want to overwrite them.
- **Tested:**
  - A re-run adds nothing, both in `node Server/AskIndex.test.mjs` and on `ux/Dictate` (19 inbox lines, unchanged on the second run).
  - A live refine of three of today's prompts recorded the new asks.
  - I did not check the page layouts at the four widths. These are generated markdown pages, with no new UI.
- **Done is deliberately strict.** It only counts when AskTally judged the feature done and one of that feature's asks came from the same prompt. I did not search landing lines separately.
